history.summary: Realistic Human Hand Card Fan Layout
changes: Arrange cards in a beautiful, natural arc (fanned layout) fanning out around a bottom center pivot point (transformOrigin: 50% 140%)
Introduce dynamic angle-step calculations based on the number of cards in hand to compress or expand the fan neatly
Enable fanned cards to fit comfortably in a single row on both mobile and desktop screens by overlapping them progressively
Calculate selected card pop-up lift (translateY) dynamically along its respective rotation angle so it rises straight up
Add style prop support to Card component to allow merging custom inline fanning styles
Group cards by suit in client UI with alternating red/black colors (Spades, Hearts, Clubs, Diamonds) as humans prefer to hold them
Move declared trump suit cards to the front (left) of the hand to make them stand out
Implement double-click/tap play mechanism: the first click selects and pops up the card, the second click confirms and plays it
Reset card selection when the active turn changes to prevent stale UI states
Enhance popped-up selected card lift height (translateY(-16px)) and z-index (45) on mobile to render above adjacent cards

history.summary: Strict Two-Row Proportional Mobile Hand Layout
changes: Set width: 96vw and max-width: 96vw on mobile player-hand-dock to eliminate CSS flexbox shrink-wrapping bugs
Calibrate card width to 14.5vw and horizontal margin to -1.1vw to strictly constrain the layout to under 2 rows
Refactor text sizes and icons on mobile cards to fit the new aspect ratios perfectly
Implement viewport-width proportional card sizing (16vw) and aspect-ratio: 2/3 for cards in mobile hand
Introduce responsive negative horizontal margins (-1.3vw) to overlap cards on mobile screens
Increase font-size and badge-size for cards on mobile to be easily readable and proportional to the larger layout
Change mobile hand card width to calc((100% - 24px) / 7) and use aspect-ratio: 2/3, ensuring cards adapt dynamically to any phone screen resolution
Guarantee a clean, non-scrollable layout of exactly two rows of cards (7 on row 1, 6 on row 2) regardless of screen width
Remove the redundant helper flex wrapper div around the Card component in GameBoard to prevent flexing/wrapping anomalies
Rearrange the player's hand on mobile screens to wrap into two rows, eliminating horizontal scrolling
Scale down hand card sizes to 44px x 66px on mobile screens to fit hands perfectly inside the view width
Refactor Card rendering to use responsive CSS classes for font styling and selection lift heights instead of inline styles
Add glows and gradients corresponding to each suit's color theme for cards matching the declared trump suit
Add a subtle trumpet icon next to the card's point value badge for all trump cards
Enhance visibility of the central suit symbol on cards when they belong to the trump suit
Create a composite gold and indigo dual-glow styling for the Queen of Spades (Kaali Ki Rani) when Spades is the trump suit
Make top-bar Kaali Ki Rani header logo clickable to return to the Lobby / home page
Make Lobby logo clickable to reset the active tab to Single Player and close rules modal

history.summary: Mobile Menu Crash Fix & Layout Tuning
changes: Import missing Trophy icon in App.jsx to resolve the mobile menu crash/unresponsive blank screen bug
Make playing card base size smaller on mobile (56px x 84px) to fit hands without overlaps
Tweak played card positions on mobile to align inside the smaller 170px center circle to prevent overlap with East/West player HUDs
Surface player name elements largely with bold font weight (800) and ellipsis truncation to avoid bot name overflows
Hide opponent redacted card counts on mobile screens to save horizontal table space
Hide bottom Game Feed overlay on mobile devices to prevent player deck overlaps
Bury Logs, Game ID and Leaderboard actions into a responsive hamburger dropdown menu on mobile screens
Relocate Trump Suit and Partner Card badges to the top header bar on mobile to eliminate overlap with the North player avatar HUD
Replace dark PWA app icons (192x192, 512x512) with a custom-generated, vibrant, high-contrast premium gold-trimmed spade design to make the Web App stand out clearly on iOS/mobile home screens
Make the Play-by-Play Trick History section collapsible in the Round Verdict modal window to prevent screen overflow on mobile
Configure default state to collapse on mobile viewports (< 640px) and expand on desktop views, with manual toggle chevron control
Elevate 'Round Verdict' (Hand Over) and 'Match Over' overlays from the 280px drawer sub-context to the root level of App.jsx to avoid clipping and allow them to take full viewport space centered
Redesign 'Last Trick Played' panel as a prominent centered modal dialog with large card previews and a blur backdrop backdrop
Reposition played trick cards on the table to float clearly outside the center circle boundaries (-45px offset) to sit right in front of corresponding player avatar HUDs

history.summary: Spacious Victory Verdict & Trick review Panel
changes: Enlarge end-of-round victory modal size (780px wide) and position it in the center
Split verdict window into a side-by-side flex layout displaying visual results banner/role points on the left, and a large scrollable play-by-play Trick History log on the right
Reposition played trick cards on the table to float outward from the center (20px instead of 120px) to sit in front of the players who played them and avoid card overlaps
Enlarge 'Last Trick' pop-up and apply prominent gold border/trophy highlighting to the trick winner
Add scrollable Play-by-Play Trick History reviews inside the Hand Over victory/defeat scoreboard modal
Expose and resolve secret partner seat on server/client game end if the partner card was never played
Implement target bid progress text (e.g. Bid: 30/95) and graphical green progress bar on bidder/partner HUD avatar spots
Fix React useEffect dependency gap causing bots to freeze when winning a trick and leading the next (added trickPlayState length and bidding logs history to dependencies list)
Create structured version history registry (version_history.json)
Expose current version badge in the footer
Introduce clickable release logs history viewer modal
Preserve completed trick cards on table until next trick starts
Add 'Last Trick' header review widget with seat-labeled card rows
Implement scrolling terminal-style Action Logs modal popup in header
Fix follow-suit bugs when leading subsequent tricks
Lift South seat HUD panel to bottom: 10.5rem to prevent overlaps
Fix checkHandEnded scoring bug (use actual defender points sum instead of subtracting from 150)
Implement automatic scoreboard slide-open on HAND_OVER and MATCH_OVER states
Import RANK_VALUES in client/server game.js to resolve 4th card freezes
Recalibrate evaluateBidStrength for realistic bot bidding (pass weak hands, scale realistically)
Set bottom boundaries on bidding overlays to unblur player card docks
Raise South player HUD positioning offset to avoid card overlaps
Implement structured JSON telemetry logs logging on server
Write log analyzer script to compile JSON records into training dataset

history.summary: Immersive Overlays, Funny Bots & Game IDs
changes: Change client board display to full screen width & height
Render scoreboard, bidding, and declaration selectors as felt overlays
Implement funny bot name generator with card/suit theme and _bot suffix
Assign unique tracker Game IDs to matches, shown in header bar
Add try-catch play fail-safe loops to prevent bot hangs

changes: Rewrite styling system to pure custom radial Vanilla CSS (index.css)
Implement responsive circular layout spots for seats (North, South, East, West)
Refactor Card face graphics and Spade Queen crown colors
Initialize client PWA scaffolding and express websocket rooms server
Build game mechanics state machine engine and basic AI bots
Implement unit test suite tests
